results.content: The static environment looks similar in the state legislature. Democrats hold a 7-point lead over Republicans in the state legislative generic ballot, 48% to 41%, which is also virtually the same as it stood in May (47% to 41%). The August edition shows Democrats drawing almost even among male voters, 45% to 46%, while maintaining a large lead among women.
